Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The initial step (step 0) where WebSurfer attempted to access the specific 2016 paper on SPFMV and SPCSV in the Pearl of Africa led to repeated CAPTCHA verifications and access restrictions. This created a loop of unsuccessful attempts, preventing the retrieval of the necessary information to identify the chemicals and their EC numbers. The inability to access the paper was the first and most critical mistake, as it made all subsequent steps impossible to complete correctly.
